correction.incorrect_interpretation: The v1 text called the lower-numbered source batches earlier acquisitions and the higher-numbered held batches later acquisitions.
correction.correct_interpretation: The allocation is a deterministic holdout by deposited numeric batch label. It is not chronological.
correction.allocation_rule: Order the seven deposited batch identifiers by their numeric suffix; assign the four lower-numbered batches to source-only development and the three higher-numbered batches to the sealed held test.
